cells.gaps: No system is shown live in stations outside Juba. The 2021 shared case system has no count of stations, and the crime management system handed over in December 2025 is not yet in nationwide operation. A thesis abstract says the force handles crime reporting on paper (SSD-004, SSD-005). Nothing on governance is dated inside 36 months.
cells.note: A case system shared with the courts ran in Juba in 2021, and a crime management system for incidents and reports was handed to the police ICT directorate in Juba in December 2025: rung 2, and advancing. Rung 3 needs digital recording in stations outside the capital, and none is shown.
